prompts.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE completely NEW color photographic-looking illustration for the Matkakirja lens catalogue, horizontal 16:9, preferably 2048x1152, intended export 1600x900 plus a center-square thumbnail.
Attached Tower Bridge catalogue image is a STYLE reference only: use its believable camera detail, restrained natural colors, real material textures and coherent architecture. Do not depict London, a bridge or water.
Subject: traditional Chinese imperial architecture representing the Chinese dynasties. A clearly recognizable compact red gate pavilion with a golden YELLOW glazed ceramic hipped roof and gently upturned corners, set in a rich RED plaster wall, evoking the Forbidden City in Beijing. The red wall and yellow tiled roof must be the dominant instantly recognizable shapes. A modest band of painted dark-green eaves, plausible continuous columns and construction. No extravagant fantasy roof, no impossibly repeated tiers, no palace model or miniature diorama.
Composition: a real-camera medium-wide view from eye level, slightly three-quarter frontal angle, softly illuminated by natural daylight. Keep the complete principal yellow roof and main red facade centered in the MIDDLE 45 percent of the frame width with clear space around its roof tips. The complete key pavilion silhouette fits inside a center square and circular thumbnail: protect the central subject from circular clipping. Low red wall continues naturally toward the outer sides, with softly focused supporting roofs, modest pale-blue sky and neutral pale stone foreground. Simple strong grouping, readable at 96 pixels. No tiny busy figures or a forest of roof details.
Authentic fine ceramic irregularity and subtly weathered red plaster, soft natural highlights, ordinary photographic contrast, muted warm yellow/red and subtle sky blue. Not oversaturated, not HDR, no artificial patterned texture, not a painting, cartoon, glossy CGI or sculpted toy. No people, crowds, flags, signs, plaques, Chinese characters, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, frame, circular vignette or graphic icon. This is an illustrative image, not a claim to document an exact historical building.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE completely NEW color photograph-style catalogue image of CHESS PIECES ON A CHESSBOARD in a traditional Viennese coffeehouse with nineteenth-century furnishings. Horizontal 16:9, preferably 2048x1152, intended export 1600x900 plus a center-square thumbnail.
The attached existing catalogue board-game photo is a STYLE reference for warm natural window light, physically believable worn wood and restrained colors ONLY. Do not depict the nine men's morris diagram, dots, round counters, a different game or its geometry.
Subject: a small uncluttered group of THREE clearly separated traditional chess pieces on a real wooden CHESSBOARD: one pale boxwood KING with a small cross-shaped finial at center-left; one dark wooden KNIGHT with a recognizable carved horse-head profile at center-right; one smaller dark wooden PAWN slightly nearer the camera between them. Each is a single upright solid wooden piece, separately based on its own square. Clear familiar chess silhouettes; no merged pieces, extra heads, floating finials or fused bases.
The board has coherent straight continuous perspective lines and ordinary alternating dark walnut and light wood SQUARES of equal size. Show a close section of this real board, allowing the board edges to extend out of the frame rather than forcing a full board view. The three pieces are the main subject, with soft depth of field but all three silhouettes and their wood surfaces sharp. All pieces fit comfortably within the central 40 percent of the frame width and central 65 percent of the image height, so a CENTER SQUARE crop and CIRCULAR 96px thumbnail retain every piece completely.
Camera at slightly elevated tabletop level, gently angled, ordinary 70mm still-life photograph. Board rests on a small marble-topped café table. The background is softly out of focus: warm wood paneling, a curved bentwood chair and tall café window imply late nineteenth-century Vienna. A small plain white porcelain coffee cup on a saucer may sit far to one side, outside the central thumbnail; no pastries or decorative clutter. Natural soft side window light, warm cream and brown tones, subtle authentic wood grain, modest patina, realistic soft shadows. Modern color-photograph quality of an old-fashioned interior, not an archival monochrome document.
No people or hands, no menus, newspapers, writing, readable signs, clocks, electronic items, board coordinates, numerals, labels, logos, watermarks, borders or circular graphic mask. No watercolor, no illustration, CGI, HDR or exaggerated orange cinematic grading. Make it readable as chess at tiny icon size.
